parameters.content:
## Job Creation & Resume Screening
 This workflow helps recruiters create job postings and process candidate resumes in one flow. It uses AI to generate and improve job descriptions, checks job quality, validates and extracts resume data, creates candidate profiles and embeddings, stores the data in Supabase, and evaluates candidates against the selected job to calculate a match score.

It accepts job details and resumes, validates the input, creates job descriptions using AI, processes resumes, and calculates candidate scores.

## Key features:

AI Job Creation
Job Quality & Bias Check
Resume Processing
Candidate Profile Creation
Candidate Scoring
Supabase Storage

## 1. Recruiter Request & Routing
The Switch routes the input into the correct flow:
Job → Job Creation
Resume → Resume Screening

## 3. Resume Screening
Validates and processes the resume, extracts candidate information, and creates a candidate profile.
The system then evaluates and saves the candidate score.

## 2.1 Job Input & Validation
Checks if the required job details are available.
Invalid input → Error response.

## 2.2 AI Job Generation
AI creates the job description, required skills and experience.
The output is converted into structured job data.

## 2.3 Job Quality Check
Checks the job description for quality and possible bias.
Makes sure the JD is clear and suitable before publishing.

## 2.4 Quality Decision
Checks if the JD passed the quality check.
Yes → Publish 
 No → Improve JD

## 2.6 Improve Job Description
Improves the JD based on quality issues.
Combines the improved JD and sends it back for quality check.

## 2.5 Publish Approved Job
Saves the approved job in Supabase and Sends a job published confirmation.

## 2.7 Invalid Responds
Shows an error for invalid job details.

## 3.1 File Validation + PDF/Text Extraction

Validates the resume and extracts the text from the PDF.

## 2.Job Creation
Validates recruiter job details and uses AI to create a quality job description.
The approved job is then published to Supabase

## 3.2 Candidate Profile Processing

Cleans the resume, extracts candidate details using AI, creates the resume embedding, and combines the profile with the embedding.

## 3.3 Supabase / PostgreSQL

Stores the candidate data, resume details, application, and scoring information in the database.

## 3.4 Candidate Evaluation & Score Processing
Checks the job ID, gets the job details, evaluates the candidate, calculates and saves the final score, then sends the resume processing result.

## 3.5 Respond – Invalid File  
Returns an error if the uploaded resume is not a PDF.

## Recruiter Copilot 

This workflow provides an AI-powered chat assistant for recruiters to quickly get useful information about candidates and recruitment activities. The recruiter can ask questions in natural language, and the system identifies the required action and retrieves the relevant information.

The workflow can search for suitable candidates, explain candidate scores, generate interview questions based on candidate and job details, summarize interview feedback, and handle general recruitment questions. The required data is fetched from Supabase and given to the AI to generate a relevant response.

The system then logs the recruiter’s chat and returns the final answer through the Copilot response.

## Key features:

Candidate Search
Score Explanation
Interview Questions
Feedback Summary
General Recruitment Queries

## 4.1 Webhook & Routing

Receives the recruiter input through the webhook and routes it to the appropriate Job Creation or Resume Screening workflow.

## 4.2 Health Check
Checks whether the Copilot service is active and returns a successful health status.

## 4.3 Intent Classification & Parsing
Uses AI to understand the recruiter’s question, identify the required action, and prepare the details for the next workflow step.

## 4.5 Candidate Search & Context Building
Converts the recruiter’s query into an embedding, finds the most relevant candidates, and prepares their details as context for the AI response.

## 4.4 Intent-Based Routing

Routes the recruiter’s request based on the identified intent.

Search Candidates → Candidate Search & RAG
Explain Score → Candidate Score Details
Generate Questions → Interview Question Generation
Summarize Feedback → Interview Feedback Summary
General → General Recruitment Response

## 4.6 Candidate Score & Context

Retrieves the candidate’s score details and prepares the information for the AI response.

## 4.7 Candidate Profile & Interview Context

Retrieves the candidate and job details, then prepares the information for generating interview questions.

## 4.8 Interview Feedback & Context

Retrieves the candidate’s interview feedback and prepares it for generating a summary.

## 4.9 General Context Building

Prepares general recruitment context for handling queries that do not match a specific route.

## 4.10  Generate, Log & Respond
Generates the AI response using the prepared context, saves the chat details, and sends the final answer back to the recruiter.

## 4. Recruiter Copilot

Helps recruiters get quick answers and insights about candidates and recruitment activities.
